geeklist.title: Giving Thanks Auction! Ends Tuesday 12/2
geeklist.description:
This auction will end on Tuesday December 2nd!
AUCTION RULES:
1. All items have a starting bids of $5 unless otherwise noted. I may add a BIN or Buy it Now price later, but for now there are none. The soft reserve is most likely the lowest price that I'm willing to accept for a particular item.
2. All games are in very good to like new condition unless otherwise noted.
3. All bids must be in whole dollar increments.
4. Shipping will be from Birmingham, Alabama 35203. All shipping costs will be paid for by the winner.
5. I ship using Pirateship and will try to find the cheapest method to ship to you. Also I will combine shipping if you win multiple items. Please be aware, shipping multiple heavy items will be expensive depending on your location. So please plan accordingly.
6. All transactions will be done via Paypal and processed through the BGG marketplace so BGG will get its 3% commission.
7. This particular auction will run until some time on Tuesday December 2nd.
8. U.S. bidders only, please.
9. If you have any questions please feel free to geekmail me. (Pictures available upon request)
10. I reserve the right to remove any item from this list.
Thanks for bidding!
